coaching_note: Now 4 days: Mon Lower A (rehab), Tue Upper A, Thu Lower B + power/ski, Fri Upper B — Sat/Sun off. Big fix: your knee rehab (TKE, step-downs, eccentric curl) and banded hip abduction moved to the FRONT of Lower A (a6 is now warmup activation), because those skips — not pain — are what's holding you out of Phase II. Zero pain flags in weeks, nice. Confirm 32.5 on the RDL before 35. Pressing's been quiet ~4 weeks, so Friday we carefully test-drive the overhead tricep extension (d11) again — light cable, stop at the FIRST tendon signal and flag it. Sessions are re-sequenced by station: superset same-equipment moves (cable rack, box, DB+bench) and keep Thursday under ~75 min.

a5.note: Lead LEFT every set (weak stance leg). Hold 20 — chase 15 clean reps before adding load. Now paired at the cable rack with a11 TKE: alternate sets, don't fully rest.

a6.note: MOVED to warmup as glute activation — medium band, 2x15, hips stacked, toes forward. This is why it kept getting skipped; doing it up front on the mat fixes that.

a7.note: Confirm last week's new load (32.5) is clean before going to 35. BRACE before each rep — left low-back soreness was hinge form, not load. Soft standing knee. DBs — pair with a9 hip thrust (same DBs + bench).

a8.note: Chase 12 both sides, then 50. 3-sec eccentric. Straight into the eccentric-curl (a10) on the same machine — no rest.

a9.note: You hit 12 on the right last week — match the left, then move to 50. Squeeze the glute to lock, don't just reach extension. Pair with a7 (same DBs + bench).

a10.note: SWAP the Nordic for an accentuated-eccentric machine leg curl (no anchor needed): lift with both legs, lower slow with ONE, 3-4 sec, 3x6-8/side. Do it right after a8 on the same machine. Ball/slider curl on the mat is the alternative if you'd rather keep it floor work. Rebuild eccentric tolerance slowly.

a11.note: MOVED UP — do it fresh at the cable rack, supersetted with a5. 3x15/side, 2-sec hold at full extension. This is your VMO/patellar tracking work — DO NOT SKIP.

a12.note: MOVED UP — 3x8/side, 4-sec lower, knee tracks over the 2nd toe. Watch the left knee for valgus. Pair on the box with a13. DO NOT SKIP.

a13.note: Progressed to 25 last week — hold and own it. 3-sec slow lower, below platform if pain-free. Same box as a12.

b4.note: → 120 if all 4 sets are clean. Max pull-ups are a fine sub when the machine's busy (you did 6/6/5). Alternate at the pull machines with b5.

b5.note: Lead LEFT — it fatigues first; match the right to the left, don't let it run ahead. Full retraction.

b6.note: Settled here per your call — ELBOWS OUT (rear-delt row, not lat). Chase 12 before 40. Bench + DBs, pair with b9 curls.

b7.note: 2-sec hold at the ears. → 60 only if 15 is clean. Cable rack — pair with b8.

b8.note: Pick one load and own it — it's been bouncing 70-100. Sweep to overhead range; do the lat stretch (b10) after for the top range. Pair with b7 at the cable rack.

b9.note: Earn 12 clean at 20, then 25. Brace the core (back twinge at 25 before). Bench + DBs, pair with b6.

c5.note: 3-sec eccentric, stay at/under 90deg, lead left. +5-10 lb if clean — this is a Phase II gate lift. Leg machines — alternate with c6.

c6.note: 2-sec hold at top, toe slightly out, lead left. Note if left VMO still lags. Pair with c5.

c7.note: 18in box, 4-sec lower. Priority is killing the left-knee wobble — slow, not loaded. Same box as e9 (lateral step-up) — do them back to back.

c11.note: Conventional DB RDL, 20/hand — it's earlier in the session now, so stop skipping it. Weight through the big-toe side, soft knees.

e4.note: NEW to Thursday — Goblet Squat, tempo contrast 4x6. Start LIGHT, this is a baseline. 4-sec down, then EXPLODE up. Pain-free depth only (no heel rise). DBs/KB — pair with e5.

e5.note: NEW — DB Deadlift, tempo contrast 4x5. Light baseline. 3-sec lower, explosive hip snap (not an arm pull). Same DBs as e4.

e7.note: Lateral Band Walk + Squat, yellow band, 3x10/side. Most ski-specific pattern in the program — toes forward, full tripod. Floor finisher with e8/e11.

e8.note: Single-Leg Balance Reach, 2x5 reaches each direction/side. LEFT leg priority. Retrains landing mechanics — close eyes if easy.

e9.note: NEW — Lateral Step-Up, 4-6in box, 3x8/side. Push through the working leg, slow lower. Ski turn force production. Same box as c7.

e11.note: Copenhagen Plank (modified, bottom knee down), 3x20s/side. Core finisher on the mat with e7/e8.

d4.note: Do it FIRST, fresh. No tendon signal in 4 weeks — chase 12, then 35. Stop the set at ANY tendon signal. Bench + DBs, pair with d7.

d5.note: CABLE fly, 35/arm. Pec-fly machine is a fine sub for availability but DON'T log it as the cable PR (per your note). Cable rack cluster with d9/d10/d11.

d6.note: 2 sets, feet elevated on the same bench as d4/d7 — work them in.

d7.note: Fix the left shrug — long neck, lead with the elbow. Load comes after control. Bench + DBs, pair with d4.

d8.note: Converging machine, NEUTRAL grip only (tendon-protective), combined weight. DBs made you arch last time — machine is the primary; DB seated only if the machine's taken. Do it between the DB and cable clusters.

d9.note: Lead LEFT (weaker), match reps right to left. Cable rack cluster.

d10.note: Pain-free — free to progress. Chase 15, then 50. Cable rack cluster.

d11.note: REINTRODUCE carefully — light CABLE (constant tension, gentler than DB), 3x12. You've earned it with ~4 pain-free weeks. Stop at the FIRST tendon signal and hit the Skipped/Pain flag if it twinges. Cable rack cluster, last.
